  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="restaurant-process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="laneGuest" name="Guest">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gChoose</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gWait</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>PG_o</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>goHatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>pickUp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>eat</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="laneEmployee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>enterOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>collectMoney</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>setBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>passBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>informChef</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>PG_k</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>waitMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>setOffBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EG</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>guestAppears</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>wait5</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>callGuest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>handOver</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>handedEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="laneChef" name="Chef">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>receiveOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>prepare</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>placeHatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>informReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>chefEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="gStart" name="Guest feels hungry" />
    <bpmn:task id="gChoose" name="Choose a dish from the changing meal range" />
    <bpmn:task id="gWait" name="Wait until it is his turn" />
    <bpmn:task id="gOrder" name="Place the order with the employee" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="PG_o" name="Order placed" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="gBuzzer" name="Buzzer rings">
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition signalRef="sigBuzzer" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="goHatch" name="Go to the service hatch" messageRef="msgGuestAtHatch" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="pickUp" name="Pick up the meal" messageRef="msgMealHandedOver" />
    <bpmn:task id="eat" name="Eat the meal" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="gEnd" name="Meal eaten" />

    <bpmn:task id="enterOrder" name="Enter the order into the POS system" />
    <bpmn:task id="collectMoney" name="Collect the money from the guest" />
    <bpmn:task id="setBuzzer" name="Set up the buzzer" />
    <bpmn:task id="passBuzzer" name="Pass the buzzer to the guest" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="informChef" name="Inform the chef of the new meal order" messageRef="msgNewOrder" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="PG_k" name="Order passed on" />

    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="setOffBuzzer" name="Set off the guest's buzzer">
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition signalRef="sigBuzzer" />
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EG" name="Guest comes to the service hatch?" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="guestAppears" name="Guest appears at the service hatch">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="msgGuestAtHatch" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="wait5" name="5 minutes pass">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration>PT5M</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="callGuest" name="Call for the guest" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="handOver" name="Hand over the meal to the guest" messageRef="msgMealHandedOver" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="handedEnd" name="Meal handed over" />

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="receiveOrder" name="Receive the new meal order" messageRef="msgNewOrder" />
    <bpmn:task id="prepare" name="Prepare the meal" />
    <bpmn:task id="placeHatch" name="Place the meal in the service hatch" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="informReady" name="Inform the employee that the meal is in the service hatch" messageRef="msgMealReady" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="chefEnd" name="Chef's part finished" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="gStart" targetRef="gChoose" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="setBuzzer" targetRef="passBuzzer" />
